repair.title: More People Came Online
repair.summary: ITU estimated that 5.5 billion people were online in 2024, about 68 percent of the world's population.
repair.why_it_matters: Connectivity can widen access to information, services, work, and community when it is affordable and usable.
repair.caveat: A third of humanity remained offline in 2024, and access quality is deeply unequal.
